layout: 7 research chapters; 8 scientific figures; operations and hashes folded

conclusions.text_zh: FULL10k在完整TRAIN4096下降不能据此推断泛化退化或停止控制臂；其完整NAVTEST同期提升。
以上是TRAIN诊断的场景差异，不能替代原生Test或作曝光改善的因果证明。

research_direction: IL provides offline driving knowledge; RL reinforces trajectories with fixed parent. Scene-conditioned safety-efficiency information audit, memory-LR-only and metric-conditioned safety/feasible-EP credit pilots; no claims of new performance.

adaptive_phase2.reason: Feedback1024 gain is concentrated; extra3072/fresh2820 no clear advantage. Broaden coverage while retaining low-score/regression targeting.
adaptive_phase2.interpretation: Explicit phase2 adaptive data policy; do not attribute later results to original35/40/25 recipe

selection.allfail: pool has no pass witness; lower mean indicator deficit by>=1/6 AND componentwise safety no worse; crossed vectors excluded
selection.cap: one representative per reason per same collection or cross-behavior scene
selection.context: signal/queue/yield UNKNOWN unless separately joined; no lowEP=wrong-stop label
selection.efficiency: EP gap>=.05, raw progress strictly higher, Comfort no worse
selection.ties: no invented direction; no pair for exact metric tie

cautions_zh: SafetyEP的100个zeroPG全部三指标+EP饱和；不能算100个失败/停滞场景，也不能用随机方向或额外rollout只为抹平zero比例。三指标通过+EP1仍不是完整交通规则或真实安全证明。
FULL的3个allfail zero中，有2组canonical0但deficit并不相同；标量GRPO丢失了已有方向，结构化优势/严格leastdeficit偏好能复用这些评分。
“同scene存在跨behavior偏好对”不等于source自身还能改善：SafetyEP已EP1的zero组没有更高安全EP替代；跨policy数据可教差actor但不证明该zero需更新。
所有已评分候选同败同cost时，数据没有相对方向；保持无偏好/anchor，并把候选覆盖不足交给另注册的探索或IL知识诊断。Allfail不能推出场景没有安全解。

definitions.ODE_vs_G8: single fixed-seed deployment ODE outcome is not equivalent to all8 stochastic training candidates failing
definitions.intermittent: zero at some but not all observed checkpoints
definitions.persistent: zero at every observed checkpoint in stated sequence; no claim about unobserved updates
definitions.relapse: observed zero→positive→zero at any recorded checkpoints
